title: Minimalist Full Body Blast
author: Louis Lestner
desc: This programme focuses on building big strength on a few key movements that will give you a balanced, aesthetic and strong body without ruining your life with constant gym sessions.

ex.note: Low incline ~15°, ideally in a power rack for safety. PAUSE on the chest around nipple height
1 main set + 4 mini rest pause sets to failure + partials
Bend over to about 60° to get a huge stretch at the bottom and come up to about 45° for a top end contraction. No heaving or swinging. Controlled aggression.

ss.note: Keep glutes engaged and form tight. A small amount of hip drive towards the end of the set is fine as long as you still control the -ve.
This is mostly there to warm your elbows up. That said, still push hard.

ex.note: Tip head slightly off bench and lower to forehead for extra long head activation.

ss.note: Ideally with a back support for stability. Big stretch.

ex.note: Glute-focused. We hit quads later in the week.
